answers.question: I'm new to the OpenMRS O3 codebase. What does the billing feature consist of, and which repositories implement it?

paragraphs.text: Billing in OpenMRS O3 is a **backend module + frontend microfrontend**, extended by a FHIR submodule and described in the docs repo. The other two repos you selected (form-engine-lib, patient-management) contain no billing code — greps for `billing` in both returned nothing.

| Repo | Role |
|---|---|
| `github.com/openmrs/openmrs-module-billing` | The backend module: data model, services, REST API, receipts, reports |
| `github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-billing-app` | The O3 frontend app (microfrontend) |
| its `fhir/` submodule (inside the module repo) | Exposes bills as FHIR `Invoice` resources, built against `openmrs-module-fhir2` |
| `github.com/openmrs/openmrs-contrib-o3-docs` | Documentation only (key-repositories, migration guides) |

The frontend declares its backend dependency in `routes.json`: it needs the `billing` module `>=2.5.0-0` and `webservices.rest` `>=2.24.0` [1]. The docs confirm the app "depends on the OpenMRS Billing backend module to function properly" [2].
It is a Maven multi-module project: `api/` (domain + services), `omod/` (REST/web layer), `fhir/` (FHIR Invoice support) [3].

- **Domain model** — `api/.../api/model/` holds `Bill`, `BillLineItem`, `Payment`, `PaymentMode`, `PaymentAttribute`, `CashPoint`, `BillableService`, `CashierItemPrice`, `BillDiscount`, `BillRefund`, `BillExemption`, `Timesheet`, plus the status enums (`BillStatus`, `BillLineItemStatus`, `DiscountStatus`, `RefundStatus`, `PatientPaymentStatus`) [4].
- **Services** — one interface per aggregate in `api/.../api/`: `BillService`, `BillLineItemService`, `PaymentModeService`, `CashPointService`, `BillableServiceService`, `ItemPriceService`, `BillDiscountService`, `BillRefundService`, `BillExemptionService`, `ITimesheetService`, with implementations in `api/.../api/impl/` [5].
- **Persistence** — Hibernate DAOs in `api/.../api/db/hibernate/` with interfaces such as `BillDAO` [6].
- **Order → bill integration** — billing reacts to clinical orders via `OrderBillingEventListener` and `OrderBillingStrategy` [7], and exemptions are evaluated with a JS rule engine (`ExemptionEvaluator`, `ExemptionRuleEngine`) [8].
- **Privileges / validation / receipts** — `api/.../api/security/`, `api/.../api/validator/BillValidator.java`, and receipt generation with pluggable numbering (`ReceiptGenerator`, `IReceiptNumberGenerator`, `SequentialReceiptNumberGenerator`) [9].
- **Scheduled tasks** — `AutoCloseTimesheetsTask` closes cashier timesheets [10].
- **REST layer** — resources exposed under `/rest/v1/billing/*` in `omod/.../web/rest/resource/` (`BillResource`, `PaymentResource`, `PaymentModeResource`, `BillableServiceResource`, `CashPointResource`, `CashierItemPriceResource`, `BillDiscountResource`, `BillRefundResource`, `BillExemptionResource`, `TimesheetResource`, `PaymentAttributeResource`) [11], with extra controllers `CashierRestController`, `PatientPaymentStatusController` and `ReceiptController` in `omod/.../web/rest/controller/` [12].
- **Module wiring** — `BillingModuleActivator` and `ModuleSettings` register global properties (e.g. `billing.discountEnabled`, `billing.refundEnabled`, `billing.patientPaymentStatusResolver`) api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/billing/BillingModuleActivator.java. The module requires webservices.rest, stockmanagement, fhir2 and event README.md.

Inside the same module repo, `fhir/` provides a FHIR R4 `Invoice` surface: `InvoiceFhirResourceProvider` (an `IResourceProvider` returning `org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Invoice`) fhir/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/billing/providers/InvoiceFhirResourceProvider.java, backed by `FhirInvoiceService`/`FhirInvoiceServiceImpl`, `FhirInvoiceDao`, and an `InvoiceTranslatorImpl` that maps bills to Invoices fhir/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/billing/translators/impl/InvoiceTranslatorImpl.java. It uses `fhir2` translators and the `@R4Provider` annotation, which is why `openmrs-module-fhir2` is in your selected repos fhir/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/billing/providers/InvoiceFhirResourceProvider.java.
`src/index.ts` is the entry point where every extension is registered src/index.ts, and `routes.json` declares pages, slots, modals and workspaces src/routes.json.

Feature directories under `src/`:
- `billable-services/` — the admin surface (services, `payment-modes/`, `cash-point/`, `dashboard/`, `billable-service-form/`), reachable as the `billable-services` page src/routes.json.
- `billing-dashboard/` + `bills-table/` — the "Billing" dashboard linked from the homepage src/routes.json.
- `bill-history/` — the patient-chart billing dashboard (`billing-patient-summary`, `billing-history` path) src/dashboard.meta.ts.
- `visit-bills/` — "Bills" panel in the visit summary src/routes.json.
- `invoice/` — payments (`payment-form/`, `payment-history/`, `invoice-breakdown/`, `visit-tags/`) and `printable-invoice/`.
- `discounts/`, `refunds/` (each with an `admin/` review area), `metrics-cards/`, `payment-status-tag/`, `bill-item-actions/`, `modal/`, `billing-header/`, `types/`, `helpers/`.
- `billing-form/` — the billing check-in form and billing form workspace, injected into patient/visit flows src/routes.json.

The API client layer is `billing.resource.ts` (SWR hooks like `usePaginatedBills` calling `${apiBasePath}bill`) src/billing.resource.ts, with `mapBillProperties` normalising backend payloads for the UI src/billing.resource.ts. UI config lives in `config-schema.ts` src/config-schema.ts.

```mermaid
---
title: Billing feature across repositories
---
flowchart TD
  subgraph fe["openmrs-esm-billing-app"]
    ui["Dashboards, bills table, invoice, forms"]
    res["billing.resource.ts"]
  end

  subgraph be["openmrs-module-billing"]
    rest["REST resources /rest/v1/billing"]
    svc["Bill, Payment, CashPoint, Timesheet services"]
    model["Bill, Payment, Discount, Refund entities"]
    fhir["fhir submodule Invoice provider"]
    receipt["Receipt generation and reports"]
  end

  fhir2["openmrs-module-fhir2"]
  stock["Stock Management module"]
  docs["openmrs-contrib-o3-docs"]

  ui --> res
  res --> rest
  rest --> svc
  svc --> model
  svc --> receipt
  svc --> fhir
  fhir --> fhir2
  svc --> stock
  docs --> fe
```

Scope that matters for you as a newcomer: the frontend only talks to the backend over REST at `/rest/v1/billing/*` plus the FHIR Invoice endpoint, so almost every UI feature has a matching service/resource pair on the Java side. Full feature list (bill management, discounts, refunds, payment modes, cash points, timesheets, exemptions, reports, order integration) is enumerated in the module README README.md. I did not read the FHIR2 repo itself, so the exact translation contracts it provides are unverified here.
